Why go: a night on Thailand's most dramatic lake

Cheow Lan Lake fills a valley inside Khao Sok National Park, with limestone cliffs rising straight out of green water and rainforest on every side. It is the most different landscape you can reach from Koh Samui, and staying overnight is the only way to see it at dawn, when mist lifts off the water and the lake is quiet before day boats arrive.

This trip handles every leg of the journey for you: minibus, catamaran, car and longtail. The 3-day version gives a full free day on the lake, which we recommend if you want to kayak, swim and rest rather than spend most of the trip travelling.

One night or two? With one night you spend the first afternoon on the lake tour and leave after lunch the next day, which is enough to see the karsts and a cave. Two nights add a whole day with nothing scheduled except an early longtail safari, swimming and kayaking from the resort, which is the best part of staying on the lake.

Who it suits

  • Travellers who have seen the beaches and want jungle and wildlife.
  • Couples and families comfortable with an early start.
  • Photographers: sunrise on the lake is the highlight.

Who should choose something else

  • Anyone with a single spare day: try the island sightseeing tour or a Pig Island speedboat trip.
  • Guests who need air-conditioning, nightlife or reliable Wi-Fi.
  • Anyone prone to severe motion sickness: there are about 4 hours of travel each way.

Good to know

  • Basic comfort: lake resorts are simple and remote. Electricity can be limited; bring a power bank.
  • Wildlife: gibbons, hornbills and macaques are seen most often at dawn; sightings are never guaranteed.
  • Weather: heavy rain can cancel the cave walk for safety.
  • Booking: online booking for tomorrow closes at midnight Thai time.
